summary: The study investigates the growth of GaAs layers on (111)A substrates using atomic layer epitaxy (ALE). The growth rate saturation is observed to depend on temperature, with a self-limiting mechanism affecting the growth rate. The growth rate decreases with increasing temperature and is influenced by surface reconstructions and adsorption/desorption dynamics of ASH3 molecules.
evidence: Under enough ASH3 feeding, the growth rate saturation of one-fourth monolayer per cycle was observed at the Tp range between 560°C and 600°C and three-eighths of monolayer per cycle at the Tp range below 550°C on (111)A substrate. The drastic change of the growth rate saturation at around 550°C indicates some kinds of surface reconstructions or site occupation on (111)A surface during ASH3 supply.
